name.basis: The strategy's own name on its page and in every EQT release; display name always 'EQT Ventures' (decisions.md). It has no adviser of its own: its funds are managed by EQT Fund Management S.a r.l. (Luxembourg AIFM, exempt reporting adviser CRD 288390, SEC 802-110840, which manages every EQT strategy) with investment advice from EQT Partners AB (CRD 160716); IAPD holds no EQT Ventures registration (45 EQT hits read 2026-09-27). The portfolio boundary is the fund family, EQT Ventures I, II and III, per decisions.md D1 to D3; EQT Growth, the Scaleup Europe Fund and every other EQT strategy are outside it.

website.basis: The firm's page on eqtgroup.com; eqtventures.com answers 301 to it (checked 2026-09-27). The standalone eqtventures.com site (2016 to 2025) was read through Common Crawl captures for the portfolio history; the stories blog lives at stories.eqtventures.com.

founding_year.basis: EQT's release of 2016-05-26 announces the close of the first EQT Ventures fund (EUR 566M) and names the founding partners; EQT AB's half-year report 2026 (2026-07-17): 'We launched EQT Ventures in 2016'. The fund's first investments (Holidu, Risk Methods, Oden Technologies) date from late 2015, before the launch.

history.value: EQT Ventures was launched in Stockholm in 2016 by Hjalmar Winbladh, Kees Koolen and Lars Jörnow as the venture capital arm of the Swedish investment group EQT. Its first bets included Wolt, Small Giant Games and Varjo, and it later backed Handshake, Netlify, Einride, Nothing and Parloa. Its third fund, EQT Ventures III, closed in 2022 at EUR 1.1 billion, and the firm has backed more than 140 founding teams.
history.basis: Launched 2016 (EQT AB half-year report 2026: 'We launched EQT Ventures in 2016'); founders per the 2016-05-26 release: 'EQT Ventures is headed by technology industry veterans Hjalmar Winbladh, Kees Koolen and Lars Jörnow'; Stockholm: the firm's page leads its office list with Stockholm and the 2022 fund release is datelined Stockholm (EQT AB, the parent, is a Stockholm company listed on Nasdaq Stockholm). First bets: Wolt (one of the five first investments, 2016 release), Small Giant Games (Series A 2017) and Varjo (Series A 2017), all rows of the portfolio; later Handshake (Series C), Netlify (Series C 2020), Einride (Series A 2019), Nothing (Series B 2022), Parloa (Series A 2023). Fund III: EUR 1.1B total commitments, final close 2022-11-09 (release). 'we have backed over 140 founding teams to date' (the firm's page, read 2026-09-27). Moved here from the copy: the fund ladder (EUR 566M 2016, EUR 660M 2019, EUR 1.1B 2022; EUR 2.3B total commitments), EQT Ventures IV's general partner already exists in EQT AB's 2025 subsidiary list, the 2026 continuation vehicle for Ventures I assets, and the boundary: EQT Growth (2021) and the Scaleup Europe Fund are separate EQT strategies whose companies are not on this page (decisions.md D2, D3).

investment_concept.value: “Striving to be the most impactful partner to generation-defining founders.”
investment_concept.basis: The firm's own statement, verbatim from its page's h1 ('Striving to Be the Most Impactful Partner to Generation-Defining Founders'), read 2026-09-27; set in sentence case with one closing period, published inside quotation marks as the firm's words. Competing lines on the same page: the title tag 'Striving to Be the Most Impactful Partner | EQT' and the meta description 'EQT Ventures partner with founders building Generation-Defining Companies (GDCs), the ones who dream big and aim to shape the next decade.'

investment_stage.basis: Entry stages on the 137 classified portfolio rows: Pre-Seed 9, Seed 51, Series A 41, Growth 29 (almost all Series B entries, four Series C: HackerOne, Netlify, Fly.io, Handshake), undetermined 7. The firm's own framing: 'As early-stage lead investors' (its page); the Ventures III release: 'investments of EUR 1-50 million in founder-led startups'. Pre-Seed entries are all 2023 or later (Camion, Generative Engineering, Talentium, Paid, MarvelX, Stacks, Strawberry, Clarifeye, Ylookup).

investment_geo.basis: hq_country on the classified portfolio: 114 of 137 in Europe (DE 26, SE 25, GB 23, FR 13, NL 9, FI 7, NO, IE, DK 2 each, PT, CY, CH, EE, SK 1 each), US 22, CA 1. The firm's page: 'Focused on European companies'; the Ventures III release: 'to invest in European and North American early-stage tech startups'; advisers in Stockholm, Paris, London, New York, Berlin and Amsterdam.

investment_scope.basis: Generalist: the Ventures III release lists 'climate tech, food tech, the creator economy, energy, fintech, software, data & IT infrastructure, deep tech and more'. Focus from the grind's focus column on the 137 rows (the site publishes no sector tags), labels held by at least profile.focus_min_companies (6): AI & Applied AI 25, SaaS 22, Fintech & Payments 18, Consumer & Marketplaces 14, Healthcare & Bio 12, Industrial & Robotics 10, Media, Gaming & Advertising 10, Climate & Energy 9, Data Infrastructure 6; below the bar DevTools & APIs 5, Security 3, Crypto & Web3 2.

investment_range.basis: Lower and upper limits: the firm's own check range, 'Investment range 2-50M EUR' (its page, 'At a glance', read 2026-09-27; the 2022 Ventures III release said 'EUR 1-50 million'), converted at the ECB rate of 2026-09-25 (1.1403): EUR 2M = $2.28M, published $2.3M; EUR 50M = $57.0M. The ceiling sits well inside the concentration check (10 to 15% of the largest fund, EUR 1.1B, is EUR 110M to 165M). | Median: Form D covers only 15 issuers, so the median comes from the entry round the fund joined on 114 rows whose note states its size (the firm's own posts and press; sources/web/entry-rounds.json, each converted at the ECB rate of the entry date): median $10.94M, p25 $5.25M, p75 $25.0M, p10 $3.0M, p90 $51.0M; published $11M. The rounds are co-invested, so this is a round-size proxy for check size, fair for a fund that leads most of its entries. Outliers kept in the count: Ineffable Intelligence's $1.1B seed (2026) and Starcloud's $170M Series A (2026).

notable_investments.basis: The five best known of the firm's own companies, most recognised first (PRO-152, Erik 2026-09-24); names as a reader knows them (COLLECTION.md s8). Also considered: HackerOne, Natural Cycles, Einride, Small Giant Games, 1X, Parloa. Mistral AI and Lovable are EQT holdings through other strategies (the Scaleup Europe Fund and EQT Growth) and are not on this page.

aum.basis: Bottom and top: the sworn Form ADV Section 7.B(1) gross asset values of the six EQT Ventures fund vehicles, filed by EQT Fund Management S.a r.l. (CRD 288390, exempt reporting adviser, no Item 5.F for this strategy; annual amendment 2026-03-30): EQT Ventures (No.1) SCSp $728,961,775, (No.2) $73,221,300, EQT Ventures II (No.1) $641,973,000, (No.2) $184,631,275, EQT Ventures III (No.1) $1,089,157,025, (No.2) $246,697,125 = $2,964,641,500 (sources/registers/adv-288390-7b.json). The same adviser files 969 fund records for every EQT strategy, so only the Ventures family counts; the EQT Growth vehicles ($2,196,003,325) and everything else are outside the boundary (decisions.md D2, D3). | The parent's figures never fill this field (Erik's delta, PRO-163): EQT AB's total AUM (EUR 270bn+) is the whole group. EQT AB's Annual and Sustainability Report 2025 ('Additional fund information for selected funds', p.180, as of 2025-12-31) gives the Ventures funds as committed capital EUR 0.5bn + 0.6bn + 1.1bn = EUR 2.2bn ($2.585B at the ECB rate of 2025-12-31, 1.175) and fee-generating AUM EUR 0.3bn + 0.5bn + 1.1bn = EUR 1.9bn ($2.23B): both below the sworn 7.B total, so they corroborate the order of magnitude and stay in the flag, not the range.

funds.basis: Three funds, all on the firm's page ('Our Funds', read 2026-09-27) and in EQT AB's 2025 annual report (p.180); sizes are the announced total commitments in EUR converted at the ECB rate of each close date, the native figure in each note. Each fund invests through a (No.1) and a (No.2) SCSp, described in the notes, not listed. Not listed: plumbing vehicles (EQT Ventures Employee Co-Investment SCSp, EQT Ventures Mentor (No.1)/(No.2) SCSp, the two German GmbH & Co. KGs, EQT Ventures Investments S.a r.l. and EQT Ventures II Investments S.a r.l.), a third party's feeder (EQT Ventures III (No.1) - iCapital Lux Access Fund), the 2026 continuation vehicle for a pool of Ventures I assets (EQT AB half-year report 2026), and EQT Ventures IV, whose general partner exists in EQT AB's 2025 subsidiary list but which no source shows as raised. No fund entry carries an accession: the SCSps' Form Ds are the (No.1)/(No.2) vehicles, not the announced fund totals.

icon_url.basis: fetched 2026-09-27 by scripts/fetch-investor-icon.ts from https://eqtgroup.com/assets/images/android-v2-chrome-512x512.png: png 512x512, artwork 416px in the source → 168px in the 256px master (0.40x); safe area: artwork scaled 0.806 (box 81%→65%, radius 99%→80%); master 256x256 opaque-plate rgb(4,4,4) opaque=100% box=66% radius=80% contrast=6.6:1 ramp=0.92px | Uploaded 2026-09-27 with the ingest, on Erik's approval, with --plate #000000 (the provenance does not record the plate). Source chosen by measurement (--discover on the firm's page): the 512 px manifest icon is the largest square mark (EQT's orange 'Q'; EQT Ventures has no mark of its own since the strategy moved onto eqtgroup.com); the page's wordmark SVG is 136x40 and would render tiny in a circle, the ico is 16 to 48 px. The synthesized white plate measured 2.78:1, below the 3:1 rule, so the plate is black: our choice, not the firm's.

hq_location.basis: The firm's own site disagrees with the Form ADV principal office, 51A, Boulevard Royal, Luxembourg, Luxembourg (EQT FUND MANAGEMENT S.A.R.L, CRD 288390, Annual Amendment filed 2026-03-30). The firm's own page (read 2026-09-27). The Luxembourg address on the Form ADV is the fund manager's legal seat (EQT Fund Management S.a r.l., which manages every EQT strategy), not where the venture team works: the page lists the investment advisors' offices with Stockholm first and without Luxembourg, its 'At a glance' Locations read 'Stockholm, Paris, London, New York, Berlin, Amsterdam', and its contact number is a Stockholm one (+46 8 506 55 300). The fund releases agree: the 2016-05-26 launch release gives Swedish contact numbers for the founding partner, and the 2022-11-09 Ventures III release is datelined 'Stockholm, 9 November 2022'. The Form ADV does not list that office. Rule (Erik 2026-09-24): the newest Form ADV principal office, unless the firm's own site disagrees, and then the site wins.
